note.es: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Suplemento para cebadero en pellet (30-32 % de proteina), saco de 20 kg; el precio por saco se pasa a tonelada (x50). note.en: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Pelleted feedlot supplement (30-32 % protein), 20 kg bag; the price per bag is converted to a tonne (x50). Monthly series in Canadian dollars. Unit conversion done by Dehesa Index with exact arithmetic; nothing is estimated.
